Evidence_Rule: pallets leave line take-away locations (LOC_LTA) in the last 14 days
PROD_TXN_FILTER: d.OPRCOD IN ('UTR','RPMSTO') OR d.OPRCOD LIKE 'LTA%' OR d.ACTCOD IN ('RCV','FL_XFR','FL_XFR_PTWY')
PROD_SRC_EXPR: CASE WHEN d.FRSTOL LIKE '{LOC_LTA}' THEN LEFT(d.FRSTOL, 5) WHEN d.TOSTOL LIKE '{LOC_LTA}' THEN LEFT(d.TOSTOL, 5) END
Prod_Model: LTA take-away (pallet counted when it leaves the LTA lane)

Evidence_Rule: pallets received from work orders (RCV / UID with a wkohdr work order) in the last 14 days
PROD_SRC_EXPR: (SELECT TOP 1 w.prdlin FROM {S}.wkohdr w WHERE w.wkonum = d.FRSTOL AND w.wh_id = d.WH_ID)
PROD_SCOPE: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM {S}.wkohdr w WHERE w.wkonum = d.FRSTOL AND w.wh_id = d.WH_ID)
Prod_Model: Work-order receipt (pallet counted at UID/RCV from the work order; line = wkohdr.prdlin)
